CV

Electrical Engineer: RF test, validation, and embedded hardware.

Experience

  • 2024 - Present

    Amsterdam

    Founder & Engineer
    klavecimbel.com
    • Designed and built PHOTON, an optical sensing retrofit that tracks key-lever motion in acoustic keyboard instruments and outputs MIDI: schematic, PCB layout, component selection, and embedded firmware, on externally fabricated and SMT-assembled boards.
    • Validated it through multiple hardware prototypes against performance targets. Published at NIME 2026; the hardware design and firmware are public.
    • Designed the boards for manufacture: chose parts to keep the assembler’s loader fees down and components available for future revisions, and chose footprints that reduce assembly risk and improve yield.
    • Built bring-up tooling that time-aligns a board’s current draw with its serial log, so a current spike leads straight to the log line printed at that moment.
    • Trained a model that recognises keyboard instruments from audio and runs in real time on an RP2350 microcontroller with PDM microphones.
    • Built a Raspberry Pi-based Pianoteq retrofit that gives existing MIDI keyboards historical keyboard sounds.
  • 2013 - 2020

    Cupertino, California

    Hardware and Software Engineer, Wireless Hardware Engineering
    Apple Inc.
    iPhone sub-6 GHz cellular RF front end
    • Built the RF test setups, not only the software that drove them: specified the duplexers, diplexers, and switching in the RF path, and developed the calibration standards and the calibration software that applied them.
    • Validated the iPhone RF front-end design against worldwide carrier requirements before the first prototype was built, with a modelling system of the complete front end (PAs, switches, duplexers, LNAs) whose configuration profiles went into production firmware.
    • Measured vendors’ prototype front-end parts, typically two or three candidates per socket; the team chose between them on that data.
    • Centralised the team’s baseline testing: up to eight devices under test at once, feeding a performance dashboard that routed each flagged issue to the engineer responsible, for a team of about ten.
    • Wrote the software for the RF test environment, including tests that evaluate device performance against 3GPP specifications.
    • Performed system-level PA verification on envelope-tracking systems with digital pre-distortion, including ACLR and SEM measurements.
    • Brought up new prototype hardware at the lab station for flashing and calibrating boards, and root-caused issues on site in the factory’s failure analysis room.

    Apple Inc.

    • Built the macOS production-test application in Objective-C: test control, data collection, and pass/fail reporting.
